title: Const Lookup Tables in ROM/Flash
description:
Lookup tables (LUTs) replace expensive runtime floating-point or trigonometric calculations on low-power microcontrollers without an FPU.

By qualifying tables with `static const`, the C compiler emits data into the read-only `.rodata` section stored in Flash ROM, preserving SRAM.

### Requirements:
1. Clamp `pwm_percent` to a maximum of 100.
2. Round to the nearest 10% interval: `index = (pwm_percent + 5) / 10`.
3. Return the mapped DAC byte.
hint: Integer division with addition: `(val + half_divisor) / divisor` provides standard nearest-integer rounding without floating point.
